facts.fact: Xalam Analytics (Jan 2026) estimates about 8-10 live commercial colocation data centre facilities in Angola in 2025, around 6.5 MW live critical IT load, about 70% of supply carrier-neutral, all primary facilities in the Luanda metro area; no facility is named in the text.

note: Market brief; no Tier statement or named facility in the text; no cloud region stated (says large hyperscaler deployments unlikely, not a fact).
